title: baccharis longipedicellata
intro: Baccharis longipedicellata, commonly known as the "cipo-verde" or "green cipo", is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, native to Brazil. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and soothe wounds. The therapeutic actions of Baccharis longipedicellata include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and demonstrate potential antiviral and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of Baccharis longipedicellata include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
